# Visual Handoff — Sample Deep Dive: The Oleshky Truce

**Coverage:** Mon 26 – Sat 31 Oct 2026 (event: Tue 27 Oct 2026)
**Aspect:** 16:9, 1920 × 1080, 30 fps
**Build:** every visual in this video is generated by code in `tools/masterclass-video/`. Nothing is hand-edited, and there are no AI images.
**Brand:**

| Colour | Use |
|---|---|
| Slate #1E2228 | Background |
| Yellow #F5D300 | Keywords |
| White #FFFFFF | Body text |
| Trap red #E5484D | Prelims Trap cards |
| Teal #2BB3A3 | Telugu States Lens cards |
| River blue #4A90C2 | Rivers and water bodies |

**Fonts** (Google Fonts, OFL):

| Font | Use |
|---|---|
| Inter | Interface text |
| Fraunces | Headlines |
| Caveat | Notebook ink |
| JetBrains Mono | Data |

**Maps:** India is always drawn from the DataMeet Survey-of-India outline. All other boundaries come from Natural Earth's India point-of-view dataset. Crimea is shown inside Ukraine's internationally recognised boundary.

## How to render

See `tools/masterclass-video/README.md`.

1. `timeline.py` turns the script into a timeline.
2. `render.js` renders it.
3. After Mounika records, rebuild the timeline with `--vo` so every visual lands on her real words, then render with `--audio`.

## Before release

- [ ] Mounika records the voiceover from `02b-voiceover-text.md` (one WAV per segment).
- [ ] Re-time with `timeline.py --vo` and render with `--audio`, **without** `--review`, which removes the review captions.
- [ ] Clear the [VERIFY] items: the Kpler figures (S20) and the PYQ wording on upsc.gov.in (S26).
- [ ] Upload a corrected `.srt`; add the YouTube card to the W43 Short at 01:22 and the end-screen elements.
- [ ] Music bed (optional): use only a royalty-free track you hold a licence for.
